limitations: Only the two-adic valuation of the gcd is classified; odd factors, power exponents below three, and general recurrences are outside the theorem.
scientific_integrity: Infinite parameter ranges are proved by an exact integer-matrix induction; bounded modular and integer tests corroborate but do not certify the infinite theorem. Full novelty in unindexed literature and independent validation remain unverified.
title: Sharp dyadic two-adic orders for sliding Tribonacci power sums
